newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen trying to go higher, eyes 1,065.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen trying to go higher, eyes 1,065.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures are still attempting to move higher but could struggle to close above the key barrier at 1,065 stg a tonne, basis July, analysts said on Monday.
But traders called the market to gap five stg down at the open after slight fall in New York on Friday.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst, said 1,065 on July would pose a strong barrier.
"I suspect a close at 1,065 is unlikely," she said. The market hit the 1,065 high on April 2.
"There is no exact level but it reaches from 1,030 up to just below 1,050."
"I don't think there's much downside risk but it will be hard to get through this time," she added.

The cocoa market made little headway in the past few sessions on the back of low outright volume. But its ability to hold gains above 1,040 provided some optimism that the market could go much higher.
On the fundamental front, the bi-weekly U.S. CFTC Commitment of Traders report is due to be released at the close of New York business on Monday.
